caption: The drawing depicts two white textile objects against a plain beige background. The object in the upper left quadrant is a bonnet with a flared, ruffled brim edged in scalloped lace-like embroidery and decorated with diamond and circular patterns, as well as a long, thin fabric tie hanging down with lace detail at its end. The bonnet is shown in a slightly three-dimensional view, displaying gathers and folds in the fabric. The lower right quadrant contains a smaller depiction of a similarly styled bonnet or cap, oriented to show the top decorated with a large, central lace medallion and surrounded by smaller embroidered sections with scalloped, lace-like edges. Both objects exhibit shading in blue and gray tones to suggest depth, and the embroidered patterns are intricately detailed in a darker color than the underlying fabric. The background remains unadorned, directing focus to the two textile objects.
title: Lady's Night Cap
